(opc) The transmission of H. pylori occurs from person to person via oral-oral or fecal-oral routes, which are recognized pathways. (opd) A lower educational level and a low socioeconomic status are associated with higher rates of H. pylori colonization, likely due to factors such as crowded living conditions and poor sanitation.
